project_memory.unknown_custom_stack_fallback: If the stack is unknown or custom, read stack.md, commands.md, and module-map.md, then inspect repository evidence before applying any framework-specific defaults.
task_start_guidance: Project memory is a compact project map for orientation, not proof. Read README.md, then compact.md, then only focused files relevant to the task. Verify memory facts against source, tests, config, docs, and gate evidence before changing behavior.
Read the generated summary rule as orientation after TASK_ENTRY rule loading.
Read only the suggested focused memory files for this task.

Write durable current-state contracts only: module ownership, workflow invariants, commands, decisions, risks, and active unknowns. Do not store repeated task narratives, transient failures, large command outputs, or duplicated known orchestrator issues. Task ids are optional provenance only and should not be the default heading structure.

startup_commands: node bin/garda.js gate enter-task-mode --task-id "T-151-1" --entry-mode "EXPLICIT_TASK_EXECUTION" [--requested-depth "2"] --task-summary "Audit current preprompt and resume reads and specify the minimum context per phase" --provider "Codex" [--routed-to "<provider-bridge-or-entrypoint>"] [--start-banner "<repo-owned-marker>"] [--orchestrator-work] [--workflow-config-work] [--upgrade-existing-task-mode] [--allow-active-task "<unfinished-task-id>" ...] [--planned-changed-file "<task-owned-file>" ...] [--operator-confirmed yes --operator-confirmed-at-utc "<ISO-8601 timestamp>"] --repo-root "."

node bin/garda.js gate classify-change --task-id "T-151-1" --task-intent "Audit current preprompt and resume reads and specify the minimum context per phase" --changed-file "src/<file>" --output-path "garda-agent-orchestrator/runtime/reviews/T-151-1-preflight.json" --repo-root "."
post_implementation_commands: node bin/garda.js gate doc-impact-gate --task-id "T-151-1" --preflight-path "garda-agent-orchestrator/runtime/reviews/T-151-1-preflight.json" --decision "NO_DOC_UPDATES" --behavior-changed false --changelog-updated false --internal-changelog-updated false --project-memory-updated false --rationale "Update the rationale for the actual behavior/doc impact." --repo-root "."
